reviews.text:
So happy I chose this boarding kennel for my baby Hémy for the first time during my trip to China. It's the first time I can travel with complete peace of mind because Doggieville always sent me photos of my baby without me even asking during my vacation, and through these photos I can see that my dog ​​was very happy and well cared for.

And his health is still great after his stay at Doggieville. I had tried other kennels (where my dog ​​was bred) twice, and both times he either had skin irritation and lots of poop stuck to his face, or diarrhea for several days…

Although the price is higher compared to others, what matters is the quality of service and that our babies are well cared for and happy while we're away. So I highly recommend this kennel, and I will always choose them if I have to go away.

Today was his last day as we’re moving to Vancouver, but we’ll be back! We just hope we can find a place in Vancouver that’s as wonderful as Doggieville! We’re so grateful for everyone who has taken such good care of our boy. ❤️

I recently brought my dog for both daycare and grooming on the same day, which came to over $260 in total. This is her third time getting her grooming done at Chloe's Paw and both previous experiences were great! Overall the staff were polite, but there were a few issues with the experience this time.

First, I was charged an additional $7 fee because I brought my dog’s own food for the daycare and was told that at the check in.

When we came to pick her up, we expected her to be clean since she had a grooming appointment that day. However, her back legs and bum were completely wet and yellow from urine, with a very strong smell. The staff mentioned they could wipe her with wet wipes, but it was so strong that we asked if they could quickly rinse the area so she wouldn’t go home smelling so bad.

We also paid for the “express wash” package and asked for additional charges for a face trim and sanitary trim. Her ears had quite a lot of hair that we expected to be trimmed, and I also specifically asked for her paw pads to be trimmed, but that part was not done. Additionally, the sanitary trim around her bum looks very uneven.

Another point is that on Instagram it is advertised that when you pay the $80 first-day daycare fee, you receive full-day monitoring and updates about your dog’s behavior and how their day went. Unfortunately, we didn’t receive anything other than "she had fun".

Lastly, when she got home she was extremely thirsty and drank her entire bowl of water immediately, which is unusual for her. I’m not sure if it was due to anxiety or if she simply didn’t drink during the day, but it would have been helpful to receive some communication about that.

Overall, the team was friendly, but considering the price and what was advertised, I expected a bit more attention to these details.
Merci! DV Pawsome Crew🐶❤️🐾 …

I brought my dog on his last day before I had to euthanize him a few hours later. I just wanted to give him one final special morning, and I truly couldn’t have chosen a better place.

The food was amazing, and I ordered one of everything on the dog menu so Armani could finally try it all since he had been on a strict diet due to his epilepsy.

I love, love, love this place and everything it stands for. I just wish I had found it sooner so Armani and I could have made more memories there. Even so, it gave us the most peaceful, meaningful last morning together, and I will always be grateful for that. 🤍🕊️

I am beyond impressed with the Doggieville team! My 20-month-old, 2.7-pound Morkiepoo has anxiety, and I was extremely nervous about leaving him. However, the team at Doggieville went above and beyond to ensure my little one felt completely comfortable and cared for. They took the time to assess his individual needs and tailored their approach accordingly.

In the past, whenever I’ve had to leave my dog at other places (like groomers), he would be visibly anxious when I picked him up. But after his stay at Doggieville, he was calm, happy, and relaxed—almost like he didn’t want to leave! It was such a pleasant surprise to see him in such a good mood.

The manager and receptionist were incredibly kind and welcoming, taking the time to explain everything in detail. They even called me during the day with updates, which I truly appreciated. It’s rare to find a place that genuinely cares about your pet's well-being like they do. Without a doubt, Doggieville is the only place I will trust with my dog from now on.
